name: Texton Property Fund Limited
source: Texton Property Fund Limited audited consolidated annual financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2026, statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, group column, from the issuer's own signed AFS at texton.co.za (R thousands): investment property income 271,008; straight-line rental adjustment (6,332); property income 264,676; property expenses (117,179); net property income 142,309; administrative expenses (40,905); operating profit 116,274; finance income 8,354; finance costs (63,638); profit before tax 37,080; taxation (3,604); profit for the year 33,476; basic EPS 10.14 cents. Revenue is the AFS line Property income, matching the FY2025 value already stored. Cost of Sales is the AFS line Property expenses, matching FY2025. Gross Profit 147,497 is property income less property expenses. Net Finance Costs 55,284 ties to the AFS line Net finance cost. Gates tie: 264,676 less 117,179 equals 147,497 and 37,080 less 3,604 equals 33,476.
